article.headline: Prairie View A&M beats Paul Quinn 86-65 behind Michael Eley’s 27 points
article.description: — Michael Eley had 27 points to help Prairie View A&M open the season Monday with an 86-65 victory over Paul Quinn.
article.linkText: Prairie View A&M beats Paul Quinn 86-65 behind Michael Eley’s 27 points

categories.description: Paul Quinn Tigers @ Prairie View A&M Panthers

event.description: Paul Quinn Tigers @ Prairie View A&M Panthers

keywords: Paul Quinn Tigers @ Prairie View A&M Panthers
article.story: PRAIRIE VIEW, Texas -- — Michael Eley had 27 points to help Prairie View A&M open the season Monday with an 86-65 victory over Paul Quinn. Eley added four steals for the Panthers. Elijah Mitchell scored 14 points while going 7 for 12 from the field. Davian Williams shot 4 for 6 from the field and 4 for 5 from the line to finish with 14 points. Malcolm King led the way for the Tigers with 22 points and seven rebounds. Paul Quinn also got 11 points, five assists and two steals from T.J. Mitchell. Jourdyn Grandberry added 10 points. Up next Prairie View A&M hosts Biblical Studies-Houston on Thursday, and Paul Quinn visits Sam Houston on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
